Cc: procurement@acmeinc.com

Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's security sync

Thanks again for your time on the call this morning, Jorge — good to connect. Recap and next steps below so we have clear owners/timelines: 

1) SOC 2 Type II report status
- You mentioned Acme completed Type II last quarter but the report is still undergoing final legal review. Can you confirm an expected delivery window (even a week range) and whether you can provide a signed bridge letter in the interim?

2) Trust portal access
- Per the call, we'd like a read-only trust portal account to pull: current SOC 2 report, evidence artifacts for data handling (retention, backups), and the latest incident response runbook. We can accept SSO invite or a one-off account. Please advise the preferred flow and the email to invite.

3) Vendor security questionnaire (VSQ)
- Acme asked for our VSQ template. I'm attaching a short SOC2 request checklist for your team; Marcus (cc'd) will send over our VSQ template and can pre-fill a few items on the infra side.

Requested attachments: SOC2-request-checklist.pdf (attached)

Proposed owners/times: 
- Jorge/Acme: confirm SOC2 report status and bridge letter by EOD 9/3
- Jorge/Acme: send trust portal invite to security@redwood.ai or confirm SSO by 9/6
- Redwood (Marcus): send VSQ template and initial pre-fill today

If any of that needs to shift, let me know. High level ask from procurement: we need either the Type II PDF or a signed bridge letter before we can move to legal redlines.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Vanessa Ortiz

vanessa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

Thanks Vanessa — appreciate the clear list. Quick answers from our side: 

- SOC 2 Type II: We completed the control testing window in June; legal is doing a final review of the report and we expect to publish the PDF to our trust portal the week of 2026-09-07 (target). If that slips we'll provide a signed bridge letter sooner.

- Bridge letter: Yes, we can provide a signed bridge letter. I will circulate a draft to Vanessa and procurement by 2026-09-01.

- Trust portal access: We will create a read-only account for security@redwood.ai. If you prefer SSO, we need your SAML metadata (email). For speed, I will send a portal invite by 2026-09-02.

- VSQ: Please send the template. We rarely complete the full VSQ; procurement typically accepts the SOC 2 + bridge letter plus a short VSQ. If you can highlight infra controls we can pre-populate those sections.

Attaching a small security excerpt we referenced on the call (acme-security-snippet.pdf).

I'll loop in our InfoSec lead if we need deeper evidence.

Best,
